tasks.name: periods_to_commas

prompts.original: Write a Python function `periods_to_commas(text)` that returns text with every period replaced by a comma.

tasks.tests:

assert periods_to_commas(' ') == ' '
assert periods_to_commas('a') == 'a'
assert periods_to_commas('x; y;;z') == 'x; y;;z'
assert periods_to_commas('--dash--') == '--dash--'
assert periods_to_commas('archive.') == 'archive,'

tasks.wrong:
def periods_to_commas(text):
    return text.replace(',', ';')
